dagaare: Dagaaba maŋ yeli ka ka neɛŋ za têêfaare ka amine maŋ leɛ pɔge o la.
english: Dagaaba usually say that if someone spreads bad medicine, it often turns around to catch them.

dagaare: N koŋ yinni a karemamine zaa naŋ wulo Dagaare kɔkɔre zannoo.
english: I will not forget all the teachers who teach the learning of the Dagaare language.

dagaare: Dabiɛ ba la sage ka o kuli a yiri.
english: Fear no longer allowed her to return to the house.
